race.description: Beaudesert Race Club Friday Aug 21 Mdn Plate
race.comment: Former Victorian TERRAX (3) wasn't too far away when having the first outing for the new stable and will have come on with that run now under the belt. Should find this easier than what he faced down south and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Sure to prove very hard to toss. BAY OF THE SOUTH (5) has just missed the frame in both outings this preparation and must be respected out of the champion Gollan yard. Looms as the main danger. NATION (10) will strip fitter second-up from the spell and maps ideally for this from gate four. Top-three credentials. POISED TYCOON (2) has placed over this distance range and may earn some minor money. QUEEN OF ACES (9) next best in a race with only a handful of chances.
